prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Unity, Tank. The one reference defines creature identity/silhouette and view. Redraw continuous actions of this same creature. Matte dark brown rock armor, pale gray-white tendon limbs, restrained amber eye slit, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45-degree game camera, upper-left soft light. Massive squat broad quadruped with thick layered irregular rock-brown armor boulders, huge pale gray sinewy muscular FOUR legs, blunt low armored head and amber eye slit, broad heavy body. Preserve the reference's wide tank silhouette. No green/red/purple dorsal sacs, no extra limbs or spikes.
Direction ALL frames: REAR view facing straight away toward TOP center, rear legs nearest viewer, back armor dominates, no front-facing eye slit; every pose is strictly back view, never turn. No angle changes during skill or death.
Strict layout FOUR columns x 6 rows = 24 separate full drawings. Tall PORTRAIT canvas, width-to-height ratio 4:6. IMPORTANT: not landscape. Empty transparent margin takes 20 percent on every side of EVERY cell, including space between rows. Full silhouettes including legs must NEVER touch adjacent poses. All drawings same scale, central placement and foot baseline. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential heavy WALK frames, four legs take distinct weight-bearing steps, alternating diagonal pairs, subtle weight shift, stable armor. Row3: FOUR IDLE breathing poses, planted feet. Row4: FOUR shockwave WINDUP frames: hind legs brace, front limbs and chest gradually lift a little, ready to pound ground, preserve full anatomy. Row5: FOUR SLAM/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame both front feet firmly strike ground with head lowered, then armored body absorbs impact, shoulders recoil and settles; no drawn shockwave, dust, debris or ground. Row6: FOUR DEATH frames, heavy legs progressively lose support, armor settles flat, head rests, amber eye darkens.
Real articulated movement, no exact duplicate or transformed still frames. Four legs, single head, consistent anatomy and armor. True alpha0 transparent empty canvas including gaps inside limbs; no floor, shadow, opaque backdrop, text, labels, grid, particles or projectiles.
